title: Five takeaways from the Jets’ preseason opener against the Buccaneers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Five takeaways from the Jets’ preseason opener against the Buccaneers
sources.description: The Jets’ preseason opener in 2026 is in the books. What was notable from this game? Here are my thoughts. Cade Klubnik was solid. There generally is an overreaction to rookie quarterback’s first preseason game. I’ll try and offer a reasonable take. The Jets didn’t put a ton of complex concepts on Klubnik’s plate, but […]
